propositions: Internal shims _engine_support/resolver.py (51 importers) and reducer/_processors.py re-exports (7 names, 9 importers) must be deleted after all consumers are migrated to canonical source modules.
Dead alias scaffolding (_LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES, _map_legacy_env) and their 6 consumer sites must be removed; no live alias table remains to clean.
Thirteen warn-class tombstone deprecations in _deprecations.py must be pruned, keeping only 6 error rows with real removed_in versions.
Unknown config keys under reserved [llm] section must warn and hard-error consistently with other sections when REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error is set.
Test hooks REBAR_HLC_NOW and REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER must be moved from production env reads to injectable test-owned child-process hooks.
Canary heartbeat source github-api must be retired; only status value accepted.
